fullContentHtml:
The RRB Technician Grade 1 Scorecard 2026 has been released by the Railway Recruitment Board on 29th May on the RRB official website. Candidates who appeared in the RRB Technician Grade 3 exam 2026 held on 6, 9, and 10 May 2026 can download the scorecard PDF. It contains details such as raw marks, normalized marks, questions attempted, and qualifying status of the candidates. Candidates who qualify the CBT stage will now be called for Document Verification and Medical Examination. Scroll down to get the direct download link for the Railway Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 Out

The Railway Recruitment Board has officially announced the RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 for all who appeared in the CBT exam. Candidates need to use their registration number and date of birth to log into the official website @rrb.digialm.com. Candidates can also log in to the respective regional portals to view their qualifying status. The scorecard is released for the Computer Based Test under the CEN 02/2025 recruitment cycle. Only those who find the scores above the cut-off in the scorecard PDF will be shortlisted for the Document Verification.

Latest Updates

The RRB has released the RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 official PDF link on 29th May at rrbcdg.gov.in

The RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 link is activated; go to the given result here to check the result.

RRB Technician Score Card 2026

The RRB released the Technician Grade 1 Result and scorecard earlier. Now, Technician Grade 3 Result and scorecards have been released with the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. It is important to note that the scorecard is available only online, & no hard copies will be sent via post to individual candidates.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 Download Link

The Railway Recruitment Board has activated the RRB Technician Grade III Scorecard 2026 download link for all regional RRB websites. Candidates are advised to download and save their scorecard for future stages of the recruitment process. Candidates are advised to carefully check their marks and qualifying status online. RRB has further clarified that any typing or technical errors in the result may be corrected later if required. Click on the link below to download the scorecard PDF.

Steps to Download RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026

To download your RRB Technician Grade III scorecard 2026, candidates must visit the regional RRB website, click on the scorecard link with the RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 PDF, and enter the registration number along with the password. The process is straightforward and can be completed in just a few minutes. Follow the steps given below to get your scorecard:

Step 1: Visit the official website of the regional Railway Recruitment Board.

Step 2: Click on the link named ” RRB Technician Grade III Scorecard 2026.”

Step 3: Enter the Registration Number & Date of Birth/Password.

Step 4: Solve the security Captcha code displayed on the screen

Step 5: Click on the ‘Login’ or ‘Submit’ button.

Step 6: Your scorecard 2026 will appear; download and print it.

Details Mentioned on Railway Technician Grade III Scorecard PDF

The Railway Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 includes important information related to candidates’ performance in the RRB Technician 2025-26 examination. Candidates can verify all details mentioned in the scorecard after downloading it from the official RRB website.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Registration Number
  • Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category of Candidate
  • Post Name
  • Qualifying Status
  • Normalized Marks
  • Railway Zone Details

rrb.digialm.com Technician Grade 3 Scorecard Link: Candidate Login

The rrb.digialm.com Technician Grade 3 Scorecard Link allows candidates to check and download their RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 through the candidate login portal. Candidates who appeared for the CBT exam can access their scorecard by entering their registration number and date of birth or password on the login page. The scorecard displays important details such as the candidate’s name, roll number, normalized marks, qualifying status, category, post name, and railway zone details.

What After RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026?

After the release of the RRB Technician CBT Scorecard 2026, shortlisted candidates will move to the next stage of the recruitment process. The Railway Recruitment Board will call qualified candidates for Document Verification and Medical Examination based on their merit and qualifying status. Candidates have to bring all original certificates and documents during the DV process. After document verification, candidates will undergo a medical examination at the designated Railway Hospital. Final selection and posting will be done according to merit, medical fitness, post preference and available vacancies.

RRB Technician Grade 3 Score Card FAQs

Q1. When was the RRB Technician Grade 3 scorecard 2026 released officially?

Ans: The RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026 has been released on 29th May on the official website after the announcement of the result for the CEN 02/2025 recruitment.

Q2. When is the RRB Technician Grade 3 Result 2026 PDF released?

Ans: The RRB Technician Result for Grade 3 has been released on 29th May on the official website.

Q3. Is the RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard different from the merit list?

Ans: Yes, the RRB Technician Scorecard is different as it shows the individual marks & performance details, while the merit list is a public PDF.

Q4. Can I check the scorecard without a registration number?

Ans: No, candidates cannot check the scorecard without the registration number, as it is the only credential used to get access to the RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard 2026.

Q5. What are the details printed on the scorecard?

Ans: The RRB Technician Grade 3 Scorecard contains details such as Candidate’s Name, Roll Number, Date of Birth, Category of Candidate, Post Name, Qualifying Status, Normalized Marks and Railway Zone Details
